## Load packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(gt)
```

## Import data 

```{r}
# Read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("eds223-hw2", "data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# Check ejscreen crs
st_crs(ejscreen)

# Filter to LA County
los_angeles <- ejscreen |> 
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA") |> 
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Los Angeles County"))

# Read in crashes data, drop nas, set crs to match that of ejscreen data
crashes <- read_csv(here::here("eds223-hw2", "data", "SWITRS_LA", "crashes.csv"))

# Check nas in crashes dataframe
sum(is.na(crashes$LATITUDE))
sum(is.na(crashes$LONGITUDE))
sum(is.na(crashes$POINT_X))
sum(is.na(crashes$POINT_Y))

# Use POINT_X and POINT_Y as the lat/long (as it has far fewer NAs than the LAT and LONG columns), convert df to sf 

crashes_clean <- crashes |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  drop_na(POINT_X) |> 
  drop_na(POINT_Y) |> 
  rename(long = POINT_X,
          lat = POINT_Y) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 3857)

# Read in json file
redline <- sf::st_read(here::here("eds223-hw2", "data", "mapping-inequality", "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"))

# Check that the CRS matches for ejscreen and redline
if(st_crs(redline) == st_crs(ejscreen)) {
  print("CRS matches") 
} else {
  warning('CRS does not match')
  print(paste('redline CRS is', st_crs(redline)))
  print(paste('ejscreen CRS is', st_crs(ejscreen)))
}
```

```{r}
# Update redline crs to match ejscreen and run the test again 
redline <-st_transform(redline, 3857)

# Check that the CRS matches for ejscreen and redline
if(st_crs(redline) == st_crs(ejscreen)) {
  print("CRS matches") 
} else {
  warning('CRS does not match')
  print(paste('redline CRS is', st_crs(redline)))
  print(paste('ejscreen CRS is', st_crs(ejscreen)))
}
```

## Visualize data

```{r}
  # Create a map of historical redlining neighborhoods, including neighborhoods colored by HOLC grade, an appropriate base map, a clear title and legend 

tm_shape(redline) +
  tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
  tm_polygons() + 
  tm_fill(
    fill = "grade",
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "HOLC grade", position = tm_pos_out("right"))
  ) +
  tm_title(text = "Historical Redlining Neighborhoods in Los Angeles, CA") +
  tm_compass() +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_credits("Figure 1", position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom"));
```

```{r}
# Join LA and redline spatial data to create a summary

la_redline <- st_join(los_angeles, redline, join = st_intersects)

```
